description: Append-only record of every MCP call — reads included — with its arguments, outcome and any document-state change.

fields.description: Tool that was called, or <transport> for a call rejected before dispatch.
fields.label: Tool Name

fields.description: Success: the tool ran. Error: it failed or was asked for something impossible. Blocked: the tool exists but its switch is off, or this site lacks what it needs. Unauthorized: the caller never reached a tool.
fields.label: Result Status

fields.description: Nearest-hop client address. Behind a reverse proxy this is the rightmost X-Forwarded-For entry — the one a client cannot forge.
fields.label: Caller IP

fields.description: v0.196.0. Which AI model made this call, from the X-Agent-Model header (e.g. claude-opus-4-6, llama-3.1-8b-q4). The client's own claim, for attribution only: the authenticated user is still the identity and nothing gates on this. Empty when the header was not sent.
fields.label: Agent Model

fields.description: v0.196.0. The client's conversation or session id, from the X-Agent-Session header, so one agent session's calls can be read together. Empty when not sent.
fields.label: Agent Session
Auth Method
fields.description: v0.317.0. How the call signed in: the shared static token (X-MCP-Token) or an OAuth client Tim approved. What list_access_inventory groups to show who still uses the static token.
v0.283.0. The client program, from its User-Agent header (e.g. claude-code/…, python-httpx/…). The client's claim; attribution only.
fields.label: Agent Client

fields.description: v0.283.0. The person the client says it works for (X-Acting-For header), or the OAuth grant's approver. A claim, for attribution; nothing gates on it.
fields.label: Acting For

fields.description: v0.283.0. For a call by an old tool name: the generic tool (template, config, record, document, share_link) that now covers it. Empty for everything else. The evidence for retiring a name after 30 days of zero use.
fields.label: Superseded By

fields.description: Document-state change, for mutations only: 'none to 0 (draft)', '0 to 1 (submitted)', '1 to 2 (cancelled)'. Empty for reads.
fields.label: Docstatus Delta

fields.description: One line describing what happened, written by the tool itself.
fields.label: Result Summary

fields.description: Arguments as received, with any secret-looking key redacted.
fields.label: Arguments

name: MCP Action Log
